name: Charlotte Water
notes: Researched from public charlottenc.gov Charlotte Water pages (Pay your Bill, Payment Questions, CLTWaterHub FAQs), read through a fetch tool because the site blocks plain HTTP clients; the CLTWaterHub sign-in page itself was not read. CLTWaterHub (launched September 1, 2026) uses the existing account number and username/email; Register creates an account. Make a One-Time Payment opens KUBRA EZ-PAY, which looks up the account by account number and street number (a street-number field cannot be expressed; reported). CLTWaterHub ACH payments are free; card or pinless-debit payments cost $1.50 up to $999.99 and $55 from $1,000 to $5,000 (rolling 26-27 day window); EZ-PAY applies the same tiers to ACH too. Payments over $5,000 are blocked except ACH (up to $1,000,000), so maxPaymentCents is $5,000. Auto Pay drafts checking or savings; the account must be active with no arrears or pending payment plan, customers choose a fixed amount or the amount due plus frequency and processing day, it cannot be cancelled within one day of processing, and enrollment fewer than 5 days before the due date starts after a full cycle (processing-day choice and the eligibility rules cannot be modelled). Payment arrangements and start/stop requests are online in CLTWaterHub. Late-fee amounts are not published on the pages used.

guest_pay.note: Make a One-Time Payment through KUBRA EZ-PAY with your account number and street number. A $1.50 fee applies to payments up to $999.99.

autopay.note: Auto Pay drafts your checking or savings account. The account must be active with no past-due balance or pending payment plan. If you enroll fewer than 5 days before the due date, it starts after a full billing cycle.

autopay_cancel.note: An Auto Pay payment cannot be cancelled within one day of processing.

payment_arrangement.note: Start a payment arrangement in CLTWaterHub from the Payments menu on Account Overview or the Payment Arrangement link under Enrollments.

cancel_service.note: Request to start or stop service in CLTWaterHub, or call 311 (704-336-7600).

notes: Card and pinless-debit payments totaling $1,000.00 to $5,000.00 within the payment window cost $55 instead of $1.50.

help.title: Pay your Bill
paragraphs: CLTWaterHub lets you pay, set up recurring payments, pay from a bank account, view bills and payment history and choose paperless billing. ACH payments in CLTWaterHub are free.

Card or pinless-debit payments cost $1.50 for up to $999.99 and $55 for $1,000.00 to $5,000.00. Make a One-Time Payment (KUBRA EZ-PAY) uses the same fees for bank, card, Google Pay and Apple Pay payments, and needs your account number and street number. Payments over $5,000 are blocked except by ACH.

Call 311 or 704-336-7600 to pay by phone. Mail the bottom of your bill with a check or money order payable to City of Charlotte, P.O. Box 5053, Boone, IA 50950-0053, or pay at the Government Service Center, 600 E. Fourth St., weekdays 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Retail locations such as CVS and Walgreens take cash for a $1.50 fee.

help.title: Auto Pay
paragraphs: To enroll you need an active account with no past-due balance or pending payment plan, and a checking or savings account. Choose a fixed amount or the amount due each cycle, then the payment frequency and processing day.

If you enroll fewer than 5 days before your due date, Auto Pay starts after a full billing cycle. A payment cannot be cancelled within one day of processing. Customers removed for returned payments need 12 months in a row of good payment history to re-enroll.

help.title: Payment arrangements and assistance
paragraphs: You can start a payment arrangement online in CLTWaterHub, from the Payments menu on Account Overview or the Payment Arrangement link under Enrollments.
Customers facing financial hardship can apply to the Customer Assistance Program through Charlotte Water Cares. For questions call 311 or 704-336-7600.

help.title: Start or stop service
paragraphs: Request to start or stop water service in CLTWaterHub, or call 311 or 704-336-7600. Your account number is on your monthly bill, in the portal and in paperless billing reminder emails.
